title: 100% Cotton, Terry Kitchen Dish towel by DII 16x26"  Set of 4-Solid
text: 100% Cotton, Terry Kitchen Dish towel by DII 16x26"  Set of 4-Solid. Ha! "Window Pane", the square design that I have seen all my life has a name! who knew? If you have a kid going off to college or to their first home away from home this is good but I think I can do just as good at a dollar store. They are thin but at least did not fall apart in the first wash. Did not have a loop to hang towel with.
